title: Flip the spreadsheet
hints: Transposing means the value at row `r`, column `c` of the input goes to row `c`, column `r` of the output. The output has `cols` rows and `rows` columns.
Two nested loops: `r` from 0 to `rows`, `c` from 0 to `cols`. Inside, a single assignment. Be careful which size goes with which index, or a non-square table will write out of bounds.
`for (size_t r = 0; r < rows; r++) for (size_t c = 0; c < cols; c++) out[c][r] = in[r][c];`
